steps.en: Install the desktop app, add a model key or point it at Ollama
steps.zh: 装桌面应用，填模型 key 或指向 Ollama

steps.en: Starts a local agent server that holds keys, connectors and the audit log
steps.zh: 拉起本地 agent 服务，key、连接器和审计日志都在本机

steps.en: Pick a coworker and state the outcome you want
steps.zh: 选一个 coworker，说出你要的结果

steps.en: Breaks it into steps across your files, terminal and connected apps
steps.zh: 拆成步骤，在你的文件、终端和已连接应用里干活

steps.en: Pauses before any send, write or command and shows an approval card
steps.zh: 发送、写入、跑命令前停下，弹出审批卡

steps.en: Approve, redirect, or make it a standing rule
steps.zh: 批准、改方向，或设成长期规则

steps.en: Delivers the file, PR or thread reply and records who approved each call
steps.zh: 交出文件、PR 或线程回复，并记下每次调用由谁批准

value.en: You get the finished deliverable instead of a to-do list — and nothing consequential happened without an approval you can trace
value.zh: 拿到的是成品，不是待办清单——而且每个有后果的动作都有一条可追溯的审批
